apps.description:
Billi is a budgeting and expense manager. It keeps your ledger on your phone and works without an account.

Billi was called Paisa. Android installs Billi alongside Paisa because it uses a new package, sh.taf.billi. Make a backup in Paisa and choose I have a backup on Billi's first screen. Billi restores .paisa files and lists Paisa's Google Drive and Nextcloud backups. New backups use .billi files.

Add transactions

* Turn alerts from about 140 Indian banks into transactions on your phone. Billi keeps the original SMS with each imported transaction.
* Type or say what you spent, or attach a receipt. Review the drafts before you save.
* Import PDF, CSV and image statements. Billi filters out duplicates across files.
* Add a transaction by hand. Long-press the launcher icon for Add transaction, Add with AI, Budgets and Spending.

Review your spending

* Search by merchant, and narrow the list with a chip for each filter: date, type, category, account, amount and source.
* See spending by category and date range, with the change against the last period.
* Set monthly category budgets and track bank, cash, card and wallet balances.
* Split bills and track who owes what.

Choose how it looks

* Start with Billi orange, choose from 32 fixed palettes or use your Android wallpaper colours.
* Switch on dark mode, AMOLED black, high contrast or reduced motion. Hide credit cards and debts from Home.
* Meet Billi, a ginger cat who is also a wallet. The cat appears during setup, on empty screens, while AI reads and on the lock screen.
* Use home screen widgets for balances and quick entry. The layout adapts to phones, foldables and tablets.

Privacy and backups

* Billi processes bank SMS on your phone.
* On supported phones, Gemini Nano can read notes and images on the device. You can also use your own key for a compatible AI provider.
* On Android 16, Android AppFunctions lets assistants the system allows add transactions and read balances, spending, budgets and recent transactions. Turn it off under Privacy & security. Gemini can't use these yet: Billi first has to be registered with Google as a connected app.
* Lock the app with biometrics or your screen lock. Hide amounts with one tap.
* Back up to Google Drive, Nextcloud or a file. Set a password to encrypt the backup with AES-256-GCM. Export transactions to CSV or PDF.

Why it asks for permissions

* SMS, to import bank alerts if you enable SMS import.
* Microphone, to record voice notes in Add with AI.
* Network, for backup, sync and an AI provider you configure.
* Biometrics, for app lock.

The same app runs in a browser at https://billi.taf.sh, with its data stored in that browser.

apps.description:
Delhi NCR Metro plans trips across the Delhi Metro and the Noida Metro Aqua Line in one app. The two operators do not share tickets, so a trip that crosses between them shows the walk at Sector 52 and 51 and a separate fare for each.

Plan a trip

* Shortest route and fewest changes, side by side, with time, fare, every station and where to change
* Weekday and weekend fares, and first and last train times
* Cross-network trips with a walk leg and split fares
* Book tickets on WhatsApp from a journey, one step per operator
* Your planned journeys stay available offline

Stations and lines

* Station search by name or code
* Station pages with gates, lifts, platforms, facilities, parking and nearby places
* Lines with ordered stations and interchange badges

Map and alerts

* A network map drawn from station coordinates, with pan, pinch zoom and station search
* The official DMRC and NMRC maps, with save to gallery
* Service alerts from both operators
* Lines, stations and alerts stay readable when the network drops

Appearance

* Material You colours, fixed palettes, dark mode and AMOLED black
* High contrast, haptics, and slide, fade or no page animations

Why it asks for permissions

* Network, to fetch routes, fares and alerts
* Photos, to save a network map to your gallery

The same app runs in a browser at https://ncr-metro.tashif.codes. It is not an official DMRC or NMRC app.

en-US.whatsNew:
* Wide windows, tablets and foldables use one navigation rail instead of swapping to a separate desktop layout.
* Settings sits in that rail, so it opens from Plan, Map, Network, Saved and Alerts.
* The app rotates with the device.

apps.description:
Namma Metro is a journey planner for the Bengaluru metro. Station names
and fares come from the public BMRCL service.

Plan a trip by least distance or fewest changes and see the token, smart
card peak, smart card off-peak and group ticket fares. Search stations in
English or Kannada, browse each line in order, follow BMRCL notices, and
pan around the network map. Stations and planned journeys stay available
offline.

BMRCL publishes no travel times, first or last trains, gates or platforms,
so the app leaves those out.

Releases are built with Expo EAS, published on GitHub Releases, and
mirrored into this F-Droid repository.

Package ID: codes.tashif.blrmetro
apps.name: Namma Metro
apps.summary: Plan Bengaluru Namma Metro trips with BMRCL fares and Kannada names

en-US.whatsNew:
* Plan, Map, Network, Saved and Alerts replace the old Search and Lines tabs.
* Save a place or a trip and start it again from Plan.
* Settings is its own page, with Appearance and About behind it.
* The network map draws terrain and water, with more detail as you zoom in.
* The app rotates with the device.
* NammaMetro-v1.1.0.apk

apps.description:
Patchwork pulls your tasks out of the places they are scattered across and puts them in one app. It signs in to each service and edits your work where it already lives.

What it connects to

* CalDAV tasks from Nextcloud or any CalDAV server, with subtasks, tags, priorities, due dates, reminders and Markdown notes. Edits use ETags, so two devices do not overwrite each other
* Nextcloud Deck boards. Drag cards, reorder columns, and create or edit everything from the app
* Jira boards with sprints, a backlog, drag and drop that updates the rank, and a full issue editor
* GitHub issues across repositories. Sign in with device flow or a token, then create, close and reopen issues
* More than one GitHub or Jira account at a time

Other features

* AI import that drafts tasks from a photo of handwritten notes or a description. You review every task before it is saved
* Bring your own model. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, NVIDIA, OpenCode Zen, RelayRoom or any OpenAI compatible endpoint
* Voice dictation
* Add a task to a calendar on the device
* Home screen widgets for today and upcoming tasks
* Material You colours, fixed palettes, high contrast and a pure black AMOLED mode
* Layouts for tablets and foldables

Privacy

Credentials and API keys stay on the device in secure storage, and the app talks to your servers directly. There is no Patchwork server in between.

Why it asks for permissions

* Camera and photos, to import tasks from a photo of your notes
* Microphone, for voice dictation
* Calendar, to add a task to a calendar you pick
* Notifications, for task reminders

Slack and Linear integrations are planned.
apps.name: Patchwork
apps.summary: One task app for CalDAV, Nextcloud Deck, Jira and GitHub Issues

en-US.whatsNew:
A new icon, shortcuts from the home screen, Siri and Gemini, and Jira issues that show everything Jira shows.

* Long-press the app icon for New to-do, Dictate, Brain dump and Search.
* On Android, pin a list or a board to the home screen.
* On iPhone, Siri and the Shortcuts app can add a to-do, start a brain dump, dictate, or open Today.
* On Android 16, Gemini can add a to-do, read today's tasks and your lists, and open the brain dump or dictation.
